first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Devon HER MDV105844 (The Crawford Hotel, Formerly Lion House, Exeter) with explicit HOUSE/HOTEL type-use bound to the same official building record. The Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap–Local Building definition publishes a generalised building polygon geometry, but its Building feature attributes in the selected official no-login window are only featureCode and geometry; no Crawford Hotel record, building identity/name, or type/use attribute is bound to that polygon. Therefore source-area/product metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
method_change: Historic England-operated Heritage Gateway single Devon HER building record -> Ordnance Survey official OS OpenMap–Local Building feature-definition window; physical building polygon semantics are explicit, but record identity/type-use attribution is absent.
